assumptions.choice: Open positions are closed via self.close() when an opposite setup signal occurs, and new entries are evaluated once flat.
assumptions.reason: Follows canonical defaults #2 (exit with self.close()), #3 (at most one position at a time), and #5 (guard pending orders).

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss orders are submitted as Backtrader bt.Order.Stop orders upon entry completion in notify_order using executed fill price and current ATR.
assumptions.reason: Explicitly permitted by specification ('Use Backtrader stop orders...'), ensuring precise intra-bar execution at or beyond stop price thresholds.
